## Grounding

Claims in this artifact are checked against:

- [ ] Repo facts on disk (README, SECURITY, posture docs, tests, corpora)
- [ ] Counts and identifiers match live sources (not a recovered draft’s stale numbers)
- [ ] Known gaps / open perimeter named where closure is claimed
- [ ] No CVE / severity / product claims beyond what the repo can support

## Review

- [ ] Reads as a standalone piece (no chat framing: “Yes.”, “I would name…”, etc.)
- [ ] Structure is presentation-ready (clear title, sections, tables where they help)
- [ ] Citations resolve; no hidden spans, asterisms, or dangling paste footnotes
- [ ] Scope of closure vs remaining perimeter is explicit
- [ ] Diff is limited to the intended artifact path(s)
